title: Cascading-failure simulation: how one shared model's blind spot propagates through a multi-agent pipeline

original_idea.body:
# Cascading-failure simulation

Build a toy 3-stage agent pipeline (generator->checker->summarizer) sharing vs differing in backbone; inject a known shared blind spot and measure end-to-end failure under monoculture vs mixed models. Small agent harness + open models; no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 4: strong chain targeting cascading-failure pathway flagged by a major safety report; reproducible demo independently valuable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: building a 3-stage agent harness is more than a single script but guided; novice+mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (cascade amplification) though the harness is multi-component.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: reusable monoculture stress-test harness from open models, weak lab incentive, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Small agent pipeline on open models, single consumer GPU, no training.

novelty.reasoning: A concrete reproducible cascade demo for monoculture pipelines appears largely undone.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No known small reproducible monoculture cascade demonstration.
